review.en: A sent-down youth in the countryside cares about two things, eating and Chinese chess. Ah Cheng's novella is spare, almost classical in its rhythm, and finds in a single game a whole tradition of calm and concentration. It was a founding work of the 1980s root-seeking movement and reads in an hour.
review.zh: 下乡知青王一生只在乎两件事：吃饭和下象棋。阿城的中篇写得极简省，节奏近于古文，在一局棋里写出一种从容专注的传统。它是八十年代“寻根文学”的开篇之作，一个小时就能读完，读完却久久难忘。
